hook.name: FlashPerpsV5Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 perpetuals trading hook that intercepts swaps on registered USDC/perp pools, filling orders via a FlashPerpsV5Issuer contract that mints or redeems tokenized perp positions at the realized NAV price, using BeforeSwapReturnsDelta custom accounting to settle trades directly without routing through the pool's AMM liquidity.
